messages:
elena-customer: Hey team — after the model swap this morning our JSON-mode consumers started failing. Parser error: `Unexpected token , in JSON at position 482` for many requests. This started ~08:30 UTC. Sample request id: req_2026-03-17_8:29:11_7a9f.

elena-customer: Minimal repro (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama4-3b","mode":"structured","input":"extract_fields","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}}}}'
```

elena-customer: Response we get (trimmed):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"name":"WidgetCo", "details": {"region":"eu-west",}, "_defaults": {"retry":3,},}
```

leah-support: Thanks for the repro and request id — sorry about the break. Im escalating to runtime/ML. Quick Qs: is this only happening for the `redwood/llama4-3b` alias? Any other customers reporting? Can you confirm this is production traffic?

deploy-bot: model-swap: redwood/llama4-3b -> redwood/llama4-3b-quantized ; canary 10% -> 40% @ 1996543180

samir-ml: looking. I can reproduce the trailing commas + a `_defaults` object being injected. Appears to be a postprocessing change that tried to merge model-provided fields with platform defaults and didn't sanitize when objects were empty. That code path runs only for the new quantized variant during canary.

samir-ml: Short-term workaround: include "structured_options": {"auto_defaults": false} in the request body or set `X-Structured-Strict: true` header to skip platform default injection and strict-validate the JSON. Example: `{"model":"redwood/llama4-3b-quantized","mode":"structured","structured_options":{"auto_defaults":false}}`

elena-customer: Tried the workaround, got a different failure — the trailing commas are gone but we're still getting an extra `metadata: null` key prepended which our parser tolerates but downstream logic expects absent keys. Example after workaround:
```
{"name":"WidgetCo","details":{"region":"eu-west"},"metadata":null}
```

toni-runtime: Thanks @leah-support, @samir-ml. We're rolling canary back from 40% -> 5% now and will push a hotfix to the postprocessing library to stop injecting empty defaults and to run a quick JSON sanitization pass that removes trailing commas. ETA for runtime fix: ~3h.

toni-runtime: Could you share 2-3 more failing request_ids and the client parser (language/runtime) so we can add tests? Also tagging support ticket #12345 for this customer.

leah-support: Adding ticket #12345. Elena — could you paste another two request ids when you have them? We'll follow up on the ETA and confirm when rollback completes. :pray:

elena-customer: Provided two more ids in the support portal (req_2026-03-17_8:31:02_b21c, req_2026-03-17_8:33:44_f3e9). This is blocking our ingest pipeline. Appreciate the rollback + fix timeline.

samir-ml: We'll also add a non-regression test to the model onboarding pipeline to validate structured output doesn't receive extra keys or syntax punctuation. Thanks for the quick repro.

leah-support: Closing the slack thread for now; we'll post updates to ticket #12345 and ping you when rollback is complete and fixed builds are staged. If anything changes urgently, DM me. :white_check_mark:
